content: Administer 15-60 mL orally as a single dose, 16 hours prior to the procedure for individuals older than 12 years. For children aged 2-12 years, administer 5-15 mL orally as a single dose. For children under 2 years, administer 1-5 mL orally as a single dose. Potential side effects include dizziness, abdominal cramps, diarrhea, nausea, electrolyte disturbances, hypotension, pelvic congestion, and hypersensitivity reactions. This product should not be used for longer than one week. Consult a healthcare professional if you experience abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting, or if there is a sudden change in bowel movements that persists for more than two weeks. If you are taking any other medications, consult a healthcare professional before use. This product should be taken at least two hours before or after other medications, as laxatives may interfere with the effectiveness of other drugs. If you experience rectal bleeding or fail to have a bowel movement after use, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional immediately. Always consult a healthcare professional before using this product. Regarding pregnancy, this product is generally considered safe. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
